title: opencode TUI theme
description: Schema for opencode TUI theme files. Format v2 maps dotted element names to {fg, bg, attributes} entries; the legacy v1 flat color keys are deprecated and auto-migrated at load.

$schema.description: Schema reference for editor support; informational and never affects behavior

defs.description: Optional named color constants that can be referenced by dotless name anywhere a color value is accepted

theme.description: Theme entries. Format v2 (the authoring format) maps catalog element names to {fg, bg, attributes} entries, plus the optional thinkingOpacity scalar. The legacy v1 flat color keys are still accepted by this schema and by opencode (auto-migrated at load) but are deprecated. Asymmetry to note: a file mixing v2 element entries and v1 color keys is valid against this schema so that editors keep offering both, but opencode rejects such mixed files at load with MIXED_FORMATS - use one format per file. Unknown names are not allowed: the element catalog is closed and unknown elements are rejected at load with UNKNOWN_ELEMENT.

thinkingOpacity.description: Multiplier applied to every reasoning-block foreground and to the subtle-syntax alpha (default 0.6); a scalar of theme, never part of an element entry

ansiIndex.description: ANSI color index 0-255, resolved through the fixed VGA table (the terminal palette is never read)

noColor.description: No color: the terminal default (none) or transparent

referenceName.description: Dotless reference name; resolves against defs first, then the palette

catalogElement.description: Dotted reference to a catalog element; resolves channel-wise (an fg reference takes the element's foreground, a bg reference its background; attributes never flow)

variant.description: Separate color values for dark and light mode; the arm matching the active mode is used

attributes.description: Text attributes applied to the element; replaces the element's default set wholesale
